info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Customer Billing Details API
info.description: The Customer Billing Details API provides access to billing information for individual customers within the banking operational services. By utilizing this endpoint, businesses can retrieve comprehensive billing statements, transaction histories, and account summaries tailored to specific customers. This functionality is essential for financial institutions and customer service representatives aiming to enhance customer support and ensure accurate billing inquiries. Use cases include generating reports, verifying transactions, and assisting customers with their billing questions.

get.summary: Retrieve billing information for a specific customer.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch detailed billing information for the customer identified by the provided ID. It is essential for viewing the customer's payment history and outstanding balance.
